scientific_integrity: Genus three and ordinary homology, and the top-degree theta class, are explicitly credited as prior results. The new part is the full first-homology action and quotient branching.
scientific_limitations: Only the first-homology representation over rational coefficients and the stated quotient branching are classified; no integral equivariant lattice or independent external verification is claimed.
title: Full symmetry and alternating-group branching of the three-particle genus-three theta surface
